articles.headline: Premier League referees' body apologizes to Man United after derby offside controversy

articles.description: — Eugenio Suárez hit a three-run homer in the sixth inning and Tyler Stephenson had a sacrifice fly in the eighth as the Cincinnati Reds slipped past the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3 on Sunday.

articles.headline: Lions escape with 31-30 win over Saints in OT after Kellen Moore chooses to go for 2 and the win
articles.description: — Tyler Shough threw an incomplete pass in the end zone on a 2-point conversion attempt, allowing the Detroit Lions to escape with a 31-30 win in overtime over the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
articles.headlineJa: ケレン・ムーアが2ポイント勝利を狙うも実らず、ライオンズが延長戦の末にセインツに31-30で辛勝

articles.headline: Caleb Williams and Bears trounce Panthers 59-37 in highest-scoring season opener in NFL history
articles.description: — Caleb Williams threw for 269 yards and two touchdowns and ran for 65 yards and two more scores as the Chicago Bears defeated the Carolina Panthers 59-37 on Sunday in the highest-scoring season opener in NFL history.
articles.headlineJa: ケイレブ・ウィリアムズ率いるベアーズ、NFL史上最多得点の開幕戦でパンサーズに59-37で大勝
articles.descriptionJa: 日曜日、シカゴ・ベアーズのケイレブ・ウィリアムズが269ヤード・2タッチダウンのパスを通し、自らも65ヤードを走って2タッチダウンを決め、NFL史上最多得点となった開幕戦でカロライナ・パンサーズを59-37で破った。

articles.headline: Burleson's bases-loaded double lifts Cardinals to 3-1 win over White Sox
articles.description: — Alec Burleson hit a bases-clearing double, sparking the St. Louis Cardinals to a 3-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox to wrap up a three-game series on Sunday.
articles.headlineJa: バーレソンの走者一掃二塁打でカージナルスがホワイトソックスに3-1で勝利
articles.descriptionJa: 日曜日、アレク・バーレソンが走者一掃の二塁打を放ち、セントルイス・カージナルスがシカゴ・ホワイトソックスに3-1で勝利して3連戦をしめくくった。

articles.headline: Nationals rally late for 6-5 win and sweep of Angels, who must go 7-6 to avoid first 100-loss season
articles.description: — Daylen Lile tripled to key a four-run rally in the eighth inning, Jacob Young and Dylan Crews added RBI and the Washington Nationals beat the Los Angeles Angels 6-5 on Sunday to complete a three-game sweep.
articles.headlineJa: ナショナルズが終盤の反撃で6-5の勝利、エンゼルスを3連勝で下す　エンゼルスは球団初の100敗回避に残り7勝6敗が必要
articles.descriptionJa: 日曜日、デイレン・ライルが8回に4得点となる反撃の起点となる三塁打を放ち、ジェイコブ・ヤングとディラン・クルーズも打点を挙げて、ワシントン・ナショナルズがロサンゼルス・エンゼルスを6-5で破り3連戦全勝を飾った。

articles.headline: Freddy Peralta, Jonathan Aranda help Rays beat Astros 14-4 to sweep series
articles.description: — Freddy Peralta pitched five hitless innings, and Jonathan Aranda hit two of Tampa Bay's four home runs to help the Rays finish off a three-game sweep of the Houston Astros with a 14-4 victory on Sunday.
articles.headlineJa: フレディ・ペラルタとジョナサン・アランダの活躍でレイズがアストロズを14-4で破りスイープ達成

articles.headline: Guerrero has four hits, including first HR at home, as Blue Jays thump Orioles 8-1
articles.description: — Vladimir Guerrero Jr. had a solo home run among his four hits, George Springer and Kazuma Okamoto also went deep and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Baltimore Orioles 8-1 on Sunday.

articles.headlineJa: ジョシュ・アレンが終盤にパーマーへTDパスを通し、ビルズが波乱の開幕戦でテキサンズを36-31で下す

articles.headline: Bengals force 4 turnovers, Burrow throws for TD in 33-27 win over the Buccaneers
articles.description: — The Bengals' new-look defense forced four turnovers — including its first fumble recovery for a TD since 2022 — Joe Burrow passed for 254 yards and a touchdown and Cincinnati defeated the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 33-27 Sunday.
articles.headlineJa: ベンガルズが4つのターンオーバーを誘発、バロウのTDパスもありバッカニアーズに33-27で勝利
articles.descriptionJa: 新陣容となったベンガルズ守備陣が2022年以来となるファンブルリカバーTDを含む4つのターンオーバーを奪い、ジョー・バロウが254ヤードパスと1TDを記録して、シンシナティが日曜日にタンパベイ・バッカニアーズを33-27で破った。

articles.headline: Breece Hall powers Jets past Titans 23-10 in a dominant season opener against their former coach
